tools.name: listPages
tools.description: List the pages of agentrq.com with their title, description and URL, 50 at a time. Filter by category — "pages" (home, contact, legal), "docs", "features", "blog" or "glossary" — or leave it empty for every page. Pass pagination.nextStartIndex back as startIndex for the next batch.

category.description: A category to list, or empty for all pages.

startIndex.description: Position of the first page to return. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: lookupPage
tools.description: Read an agentrq.com page as Markdown, with every link and image as an absolute URL. Leave url empty to read the page the user is on.

url.description: An agentrq.com page: an absolute URL such as "https://agentrq.com/docs/tasks" or a path such as "/docs/tasks".

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Take the user to an agentrq.com page. Only pages that listPages returns can be opened; a "#section" on the URL is kept.

url.description: An agentrq.com page: an absolute URL such as "https://agentrq.com/docs/tasks" or a path such as "/docs/tasks".
